findings.detail: D06 reports only 7 of 788 issuers persist, but raw 2025 and 2024 schedule rows contain repeated issuer names across the comparative schedules.

rationale: The aggregate fair-value anchor is intact: the filing shows Total Investments fair value of 35,918,948 thousand, matching the extracted fund-quarter fair value of 35,918.948 million. The D06 low-continuity premise is contradicted by raw comparative schedule rows: for example, Lightbeam Bidco, Motus Group, Pluralsight, and Paradigmatic Holdco recur across the 2025 and 2024 schedule sections. This supports a check/rule-scope false alarm rather than a source data defect.
